title: Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources
what_it_is: Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources

sections.label: Sustainable Singapore Blueprint 2015 vision
sections.summary: The Sustainable Singapore Blueprint 2015 set out the vision and plans for Singapore to remain the best home for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Sustainable Singapore Blueprint (SSB) 2015 outlined our vision and plans to ensure that Singapore remains the best home for Singaporeans to enjoy a good quality of life.

sections.label: Tightening emission standards
sections.summary: Vehicular and industrial emission standards will be tightened to further reduce sources of air pollution.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To achieve this, we will further reduce sources of air pollution by tightening vehicular and industrial emission standards.

sections.label: Paris COP-21 climate agreement
sections.summary: Last December the world adopted a historic agreement at COP-21 under the UNFCCC in Paris to combat climate change.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Last December, the world adopted a historic agreement at the 21st Conference of the Parties (COP-21) under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in Paris to combat climate change.

sections.label: Environmental infrastructure and Water Master Plan
sections.summary: Investment in environmental infrastructure and technology will continue, and the Water Master Plan is being reviewed for a sustainable water supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We will continue to invest in good environmental infrastructure and technology for a more resilient future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: We are reviewing the Water Master Plan to ensure a reliable and sustainable water supply for generations to come.

sections.label: Adaptation plans and stakeholder cooperation
sections.summary: Adaptation plans for key national assets will be reviewed as knowledge becomes available, and MEWR will work with stakeholders to realise the SSB 2015 vision.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: On the broader front, we are working with other Government agencies to build resiliency in our key national assets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These adaptation plans will be regularly reviewed as new knowledge becomes available to ensure that we are prepared for potential climate change impacts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: MEWR will work closely with all our stakeholders – Government agencies, businesses and the community – to realise the vision outlined in the SSB 2015.
